links.inference_note: "This irrigation practice" refers to the sensor-based (soil moisture sensor) irrigation named in the preceding sentence, and the cited study [62] concerns a subsurface soil moisture sensor, so the 16% water saving is attributed to soil-sensor-based irrigation.
